components.description: Paid leave bank accrued by regular nine-month faculty (nine days per academic year, capped at 100 days), usable only for FMLA-qualifying absences during the academic employment period, from the sixth work day of the absence; replaced sick leave for nine-month faculty.
components.mechanism_note: An accrued bank (four hours per pay period, nine days a year, capped at 800 hours) limited to FMLA events; R1's own example (New Mexico State Faculty Care Leave -> own_accrual).
components.faculty_group_note: regular full time and part time nine-month faculty (ARP 8.42 Part 2, 'Eligible Faculty')
components.eligible_parent_wording: FMLA Qualifying Events are as defined in the Family Medical Leave Act (birth of a son or daughter, placement for adoption or foster care; the employee's own serious health condition)
components.entitlement_note: The rule offers the benefit and says it will be used for qualifying events; HR Benefits Services reviews and approves leave for FMLA qualifying events, i.e. whether the event qualifies, not whether the benefit exists (V2).
components.duration_note: The balance, not a childbirth period: accrual of nine days per full academic year (four hours per pay period) to a cap of 800 hours (100 days). A member with two years of service hired after 2015-08-17 holds about 18 days; earlier hires received accrual credit for up to ten years of service. For the faculty member's own medical condition the balance may be used beyond FMLA's 12 work weeks, with medical documentation.
components.pay_fraction: paid leave from the accrued balance (regular salary)
components.medical_certification_note: Medical documentation required when the balance is used beyond the 12 FMLA work weeks for the faculty member's own medical condition.
components.time_window: only during the nine-month academic employment period; only for an FMLA qualifying event; used from the 6th work day of the absence
components.notice: Faculty members must notify their department head on every occasion they are unavailable to work; HR Benefits Services reviews and approves FMLA-qualifying leave.
components.relief_note: No work may be requested while on Faculty Care Leave; departments arrange coverage.

sequence.note: Pay from the balance for the FMLA leave, which the rule designates from the 6th work day; FMLA is unpaid once the balance is exhausted (S1). Use beyond FMLA for own medical condition is pay only (U6, R1) and is not placed.

notes: Reference date 2018-03-02; reference period academic year 2017-18. No New Mexico rows in statutory_baseline.csv; the two US rows are accounted for.

Population: the standard tenure-stream appointment is nine-month (academic year). Nine-month faculty have no sick or annual leave; ARP 8.43 Part 3 is superseded by ARP 8.42 Faculty Care Leave. Twelve-month faculty accrue annual and sick leave (c4, coded for the twelve-month group). 2018_01 is an HR index page: its leave-type table only lists policies; its tenure-count sentence duplicates ARP 8.40 (c10).

Source precedence: 2018_00 (HR summary, Revision 08252015) restates ARP 8.42; ARP 8.42 (amended 11/08/2016) governs. They differ only on the twelve-month-to-nine-month sick-leave conversion (600 vs 800 hours), which affects no component. The summary's statement that FCL replaces Policy 7.20.75(c) matches ARP 8.43 Part 3.
No dedicated parental, maternity, childbirth or adoption leave, and no teaching relief or modified duties for new parents, appears in any saved document (C1, C2 searched).
FMLA intermittent bonding leave (ARP 8.45: considered upon request and allowed except where unduly disruptive) is recorded in c3's description; it is a form of the FMLA leave, not added time.

Faculty leave length: ARP 8.40 'Faculty leaves normally do not exceed 1 year' is read as a general limit on any single faculty leave, noted on c5 (LWOP) in duration_note; not entered in leave_limits because it caps no combination of the birth-related leaves (FMLA 12 workweeks plus 5 days is far below it).

Cross-references named but not saved: HRS Benefit Services FMLA procedural guidelines (benefits.nmsu.edu/leave-holidays/fmla/); Policy 7.20.25 Annual Leave; 7.20.75 Sick Leave (old number of ARP 8.43, saved) and 7.20.75(c) (superseded); 7.20.80 Sick Leave Bank; 7.20.05, 7.20.10, 7.20.15 absences; 7.08 Employee Assistance Program; 7.20.30 Compassionate Leave; 7.20.32 Domestic Abuse Leave; 7.20.35 Educational Leave / Tuition Remission; 7.20.40 Externally funded employees; 7.20.50 Jury Duty; 7.20.55 Military; 7.20.60 Professional Leave (Without Pay) and ARP 8.53; ARP 8.52 Educational; 7.20.65 Leave Records; 7.20.70 Sabbatical; 7.20.85 LWOP (old number of ARP 8.55, saved); 5.45.10 Department Heads Leave; Policies 7.15.05, 7.15.25 (history of ARP 8.43); ARP 6.30, 6.61, 9.25, 9.36, 9.43; RPM 3.00; ARP 3.13; Combined P & T Rules Through 08/12/2018 (PDF). Those that could bear on a parent's leave (FMLA guidelines, Annual Leave, Sick Leave Bank, Professional Leave, ARP 9.25 / Combined P & T Rules) are flagged on the related components. Leaves that a parent could not use for a birth (compassionate, domestic abuse, jury, military, voting, course registration, interviews, sabbatical, educational) are not components.

Chain, birth parent: regular-work-time pay for work days 1-5 (c2, 1 week) -> FMLA 12 workweeks (c3) with the Faculty Care Leave balance as pay within it from its start (c1, own balance, counts 0); FCL may continue past FMLA for own medical condition (pay only, not placed). Tenure clock c6 (1 year) alongside.
Chain, non-birth parent: regular-work-time pay for work days 1-5 (c2) -> FMLA 12 workweeks (c3) with the Faculty Care Leave balance within it (c1). Tenure clock c6 alongside.
